title: AI Materials Discovery
summary: Machine learning used to screen candidate materials for semiconductors, batteries and catalysts before physical synthesis.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

ML-guided discovery of novel materials for batteries, semiconductors, drugs.

Working prototypes demonstrated. Engineering challenges remain before commercial deployment. Our research database tracks 15 independent sources on this technology.

businessMeaning: The bottleneck is experimental validation, so buyers should judge platforms by how many candidates reach a lab, not by database size.
investmentLens: A crowded early-stage field; durable value likely sits with labs and foundries that own characterisation data rather than with model vendors.
